notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.content:
Game tested on Steam Remote Play Together feature and works wonderful!
You don't need to bring your friends for couch play, now thanks to "Gaben Lord and Savoir™" you can invite them to play through internet.
(Bonus: only one player [the host] needs to have copy of Pigeon Fight!)

[list]
[*] 2 New Items
[*] Small changes in UI
[*] Better readability of Bonuses
[*] Better camera zoom :)
[*] All maps unlocked!!!!!!!
[*] Updated engine version (more FPS)
[*] Fixed disappearing poop bug
[*] Fixed saves breaking during game update (duh!)
[/list]

notes.title: 2017/12/22 Xmas update [1.1.0]!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30785552/c8db44aed887854a9e1fe8daf7177905d81fa719.png[/img]
[h1]1.1.0[/h1]
[list]
[*] Repaired language problems on first start of game! (We are very sorry that it happen :<)
[*] Finally completed achievements system!
[*] New map: "Unicorn Stable"
[*] 30 new outfits and poops to buy in shop :)
[*] Added new levels of difficulty for AI
[*] Now game supports additional screen resolutions for example 21:9
[*] New visual effects!
[*] Better compatibility with steam API (but we are gonna improve it)!
[/list]

notes.title: 15/10/2017 Razer Update!
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30785552/834e56416bcb234bde3fc81afe717160c09dfac6.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30785552/2c9c8d62f8acf1e36ee1252f01601c228360050c.png[/img][/url]
[h1]Razer[/h1]
We are happy to announce that we added a lot of animations for Razer Hardware (Chroma)!

We are currently supporting:
[list]
[*] Headset
[*] Keyboard
[*] Mouse
[*] Mousepad
[*] ChromaLink
[/list]

[h1]Fixed[/h1]
Additionally, fixed:
[olist]
[*] Progression in achievements.
[*] AI going crazy after match finish.
[*] Icons on screen while setting up gamepad controls.
[*] Crown stuck in Pigeon King.
[*] Fixed background in author's sub-menu.
[*] Corrected language files.
[/olist]

And finally! Linux version works and can be downloaded along with Windows version!
